topic: 默认模式网络（Default Mode Network，DMN）

sources.title: A default mode of brain function
sources.authors: Raichle ME, MacLeod AM, Snyder AZ, Powers WJ, Gusnard DA, Shulman GL
sources.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
sources.usage: 奠基性原始研究：命名默认模式，描述任务中一致性去激活
sources.reliability: 极高（奠基论文，多次独立重复）

sources.title: The human brain is intrinsically organized into dynamic, anticorrelated functional networks
sources.authors: Fox MD, Snyder AZ, Vincent JL, Corbetta M, Van Essen DC, Raichle ME
sources.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
sources.usage: DMN-TPN 反相关的原始发现；静息态内在组织
sources.reliability: 高（影响力极大）；方法论注意：使用了 GSR，可能放大反相关
sources.methodological_note: Global signal regression (GSR) 使用争议

sources.title: The brain's default network: anatomy, function, and relevance to disease
sources.authors: Buckner RL, Andrews-Hanna JR, Schacter DL
sources.usage: 里程碑综述：DMN 解剖、功能和疾病关联的系统整合
sources.reliability: 极高（综述，被引1万次以上）

sources.title: Cortical hubs revealed by intrinsic functional connectivity: mapping, assessment of stability, and relation to Alzheimer's disease
sources.authors: Buckner RL, Sepulcre J, Talukdar T, Krienen FM, Liu H, Hedden T, Andrews-Hanna JR, Sperling RA, Johnson KA
sources.usage: DMN 枢纽节点与 Aβ 优先沉积的关联；AD 病理与 DMN 的联系

sources.title: The brain's default network and its adaptive role in internal mentation
sources.usage: 核心来源：双子系统详述（MTL 子系统 vs dMPFC 子系统）；枢纽节点功能；心理游走数据；内部心理活动综述
sources.reliability: 高（开放全文综述，证据充分）

sources.title: Contributions of episodic retrieval and mentalizing to autobiographical thought: evidence from functional neuroimaging, resting-state connectivity, and fMRI meta-analyses
sources.authors: Andrews-Hanna JR, Saxe R, Yarkoni T
sources.usage: 子系统功能分离的元分析证据：MTL→情节提取，dMPFC→心智化

sources.title: The brain's default mode network
sources.usage: DMN 奠基人的权威综述；跨物种保守性；领域历史

sources.title: The Functional Convergence and Heterogeneity of Social, Episodic, and Self-Referential Thought in the Default Mode Network
sources.authors: Wen T, Mitchell DJ, Duncan J
sources.usage: 修正强分离模型：子系统在不同任务中高度整合；三子系统分析
sources.reliability: 中-高（与 Andrews-Hanna 2014 结果有分歧，纳入争议）

sources.title: Self-processing and the default mode network: interactions with the mirror neuron system
sources.usage: 自我处理与 DMN；体化自我与心智化自我的区分
sources.reliability: 中（理论综述；镜像神经元系统普遍性仍有争议）
sources.caveat: Mirror neuron system in primates has ongoing debate about universality

source_summary.note: 无官方机构来源（NIH/NINDS等），因为DMN是纯基础研究领域；官方机构背景信息参考了BRAIN Initiative相关描述
